name: folder-branches
description: Two side panes. Git: each folder directly inside the session's folder with the git branch checked out in it, or "no git"; /git opens it. Workers: the project's chats, who is working on what, which step, how long, and whose turn it is; /workers opens it. The app's own notes in a prompt (system reminders, side-session events, messages from another chat) are never filed as the person's instructions. A chat in the list also takes what the person answered for it on the worker board and types it in as their own words, and tells the board why one could not be typed. An answer that ends with a "For you" block the chat filed no ask for has its items filed on the board when the turn ends. After the turn in which a worker reported its step it is compacted when large (list.json "compactAbove", 250000 tokens unless set, 0 for never) or, with list.json "afterStep": "clear", cleared with /clear even when more work follows: the worker board first keeps the conversation as a log, the card moves to the new session, and the fresh conversation is told who it is, where its rules and log are, its open instructions, and to run work next. The main chat and the partners are never cleared; they are compacted at rest above the threshold. Each call of the work tool carries a request id, so a call whose answer is slow or cut off is asked again and recorded once; a board that does not answer is named with its reason. When the person pauses all chats on the board, each chat is told at its next batch of tool calls to write its checkpoint and end its turn; after the resume the main chat is told whom to wake, and each chat holding a step its checkpoint. A chat renamed in the app follows the name the board shows it under: refused under its old name, it joins under the new one and asks once more. The chat the list names "supervisor" reads the board's health summary (work health) and files incidents (work incident), and is cleared after every turn of its own, without a log, so each sweep starts empty. Every call to the board says the mod's version, so the board sees a chat on an older mod.
